more_info.overview: Talc is used as a sweetener in food. Its technological role is to provide sweetness.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include chewing gum, whole broken or flaked grain, non-heat-treated processed meat, heat-treated meat products. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: A naturally occurring hydrated magnesium silicate mineral. Food-grade talc is required to be free of asbestos.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA could not assess food-use safety because the toxicology data were insufficient in 2018.
The former shared silicate intake limit was considered obsolete.
